topic: Projectile Motion and Launch Angle Effects
key_concepts: A projectile is an object launched with an initial velocity at an angle and follows a curv
Projectile motion combines independent horizontal and vertical components.
Horizontal motion has constant velocity and zero acceleration.
Vertical motion behaves like free fall with constant downward acceleration of 9.8 m/s².
Vertical velocity decreases to zero at maximum height and then increases downward.
Horizontal velocity is unaffected by gravitational force.
Launch angle affects maximum height and range.
Maximum range is achieved at a 45° launch angle.
Complementary launch angles produce the same range.
Larger launch angles produce greater maximum height.
